title: baton context
description: Schema for a baton context.yaml. See context.example.yaml for the annotated version. Validate a context with `baton:doctor`, or directly: baton/scripts/validate-context.sh <path>.

name.description: Short name for the context; also names its `<name>-start` shell command.

default.description: Fallback context when cwd matches no member repo. Exactly one context should set this.

type.description: Tracker backend. `beads` is the only one implemented today.

dir.description: Path to the .beads directory; exported as $BEADS_DIR by the shell integration.

owner.description: User or org owning this context's repos. Required by baton:new-repo.

home.description: The workspace repo holding this context.yaml and its guidance file.

worktree_base.description: Worktree location template. {code_root} and {repo} are substituted.

member_repos.description: Repos in this context — the cwd-based auto-detection key. Paths or globs.

home.description: Where `<name>-start` opens the orchestrator. `inline` (default): the calling shell. `tmux-session`: a dedicated per-context tmux session, created once and reattached thereafter.

handoff.description: How a worker session is opened. Only used by the worktree-new-session work mode.

launcher.description: Command that opens the session. Empty means plain tmux (no wrapper).

naming.description: Overrides for the task identity group. Omit entirely to take the plugin defaults. Placeholders: {leaf} {slug} {slug_prose} {jira}; session_name and session_title additionally get {branch} and {dir}. {jira} is supplied at creation time and recorded in the worktree's identity carrier, so it survives later re-derivation.

slug.description: `written` (default): baton:start reads the bead and writes 2-4 concrete words. `slugify`: mechanically truncate the title.

branch.description: Git branch name. Default "{leaf}-{slug}". Used RAW, so '/' and uppercase are allowed — e.g. "{jira}/{slug}" for an org that mandates DOT-1234/description. Identity is carried by the worktree's identity carrier, not by this string, so it is free-form.

dir.description: Worktree directory name, under worktree_base. Default "{leaf}-{slug}", which keeps the bead id visible in the path. Sanitized to a single path segment ('/' becomes '-', characters outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] become '-').

session_name.description: tmux session name. Placeholders: {leaf} {slug} {slug_prose} {jira} {branch} {dir}. Sanitized to [A-Za-z0-9_-].

session_title.description: Claude Code session title. Same placeholders as session_name.

home_session.description: tmux session name for the home session (work_mode.home: tmux-session). Only placeholder: {context}. Sanitized to [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Default "{context}-home".

required_tools.description: Extra tools baton:doctor should verify, beyond its baseline.

startup_tasks.description: What baton:session-start runs, in order. Keywords align/doctor/cleanup/status, or any custom shell command or natural-language step.

guidance.description: Filename, relative to `home`, of the evolving preferences doc every skill loads.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks. Each entry is a shell command or a natural-language instruction. Every action sees the identity group (LEAF, SLUG, BR, SESSION_NAME, SESSION_TITLE) in its environment.
